tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mkha' 'gro snying thig gi lo rgyus rin po che'i phreng ba bzhugs so/ /

mkha' 'gro snying thig gi lo rgyus rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos sku'i mkha' la longs sku'i dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /sprul sku'i zer gyis 'gro blo'i mun pa sel/ / rim gsum bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal te/ /lo rgyus rin chen phreng ba 'bri bar bya/ / 'dir bka' thams cad kyi rgyal po/ man ngag thams cad kyi snying po/ lung thams cad kyi phyi mo/ theg pa thams cad kyi yang rtse/ 'od gsal rdo rje snyingapo/ mkha' 'gro snying thig gi lo rgyus la gsum ste/ rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa/ rig 'dzin brda'i brgyud pa/ gang zag snyan khung du brgyud pa'o/ /dang po ni bdag cag gi ston pa bcom ldan 'das dpal kun tu bzang po nyid gzhi gdod ma'i gnas lugs su mngon par byang chub ste sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i dgongs pa las mi g.yo bar bzhugs pa'i tshul la/ nang 'od gsal chos kyi sku'i gnas skabs ni/ ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum gnas pas rnam pa yul la mi spyod pa'i phyir thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes ngang gis 'od gsal ba'o / / de'i tshe gnas phun sum tshogs pa chos kyi sku zhing na/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa dpal kun tu bzang po/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa ye shes rgya mtsho'i tshogs la/ dus phun sum tshogs pa chos nyid 'pho 'gyur med pa'i tshe/ chos phun sum tshogs pa rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po rang chas lhun gyis grub pa'i ngang du 'od gsal ba'o/ /de nas de nyid kyi ngang las ma g.yos bzhin du rang snang longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rang byung ba ni/ rang bzhin gyi snang cha las rnam dag stug po bkod pa bde ba'i zhing thams cad kyang ye shes lnga'i rang mdangs las byung ba/ steng dang 'og dang phyogs mtshams ma yin zhing 'od khyim rin po che'i khang bu bkod legs pa na/ rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas so so'i dkyil 'khor gyi tshom bu 'bum phrag brjod las 'das pas bskor ba rnams kyang*/

gdul bya dang 'dul byed ma yin zhing rang snang lhun gyis grub pa'i mnga' dbang du rang byung ba'o/ /de nyid kyi snang cha las rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phro zhing snang ba thams cad kyang*/ za 'og gi ber khyim bkram pa ltar bkod legs shing kha dog lngar 'od 'bar ba ni/ zhal dang ljags kyi dkyil 'khor las yi ge drug gi 'od zer mu med pa 'phros pa las rang byung ba'o/ /de'i tshe gnas phun sum tshogs pa rang snang stug po bkod par/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa sangs rgyas kyi dkyil 'khor tshad med pas bskor ba la/ chos phun sum tshogs pa ye shes 'od gsal ba'i dgongs pa/ dus phun sum tshogs pa chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshe rang chas su rang gis 'od gsal ba'i dgongs pa brjod pa med par ston to/ /de nyid kyi ngang las sprul pa mngon par 'phro ba ni/ gdul bya'i dbang las rang snang ba chu'i zla ba lta bus te/ 'di'i dus su steng 'og phyogs mtshams kyi 'gro ba rigs drug so so'i 'khrul pa'i dbang gis rang rang gi gnas dang bde sdug gi snang ba du ma la spyod pa'i sems kyi 'khrul pa la zhen pa'i tshe/ sa dang po nas bcu pa'i bar gyi sems dpa' rnams la phyogs bcu'i zhing du/ rang bzhin sprul pa'i rigs lnga so sor snang bas don mdzad cing 'gro ba drug gi gnas su thub pa bcom ldan 'das grangs med pas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing don mdzad pa las/ re zhig mi mjed 'dir sprul pa'i 'phro tshul ni/ de ltar rang snang stug po bkod pa'i zhing nas sprul pa chen po gnyis snang ba las/ byin rlabs mchog gi sprul pa ni gsum ste/ rin po che brgya rtsa gcig gi rgyu las byung bar rang snang ba'i sku gzugs 'gro ba gang gi tshe lo'i lus bongs dang mnyam pa las/ cho 'phrul du ma 'byung bas 'gro ba grol bar byed pa dang*/

rin po che las rang byung bar snang ba'i yi ge chen po bstan pa bu gcig las chos kyi rnam grangs brjod du med pa rang sgrogs pas don byed pa dang*/ chos nyid rdo rje tshe lo de pa'i mi rnams kyi chag gang ba las gang la gang 'dod kyi chos dang yo byad kyi char 'bab nyid grol bar byed pa gsum ste/ yi ge yang skad rigs mi gcig pa gang gi sgra skad der grags pa'o/ /de dag gi 'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu kun tu 'od zer 'gyed cing 'gro ba dpag tu med pa rang bzhin gyis 'bad pa med par grol ba'i phrin las mdzad de/ sku gsung thugs las rang byung ba'i sprul pa chen po zhes bya'o/ /ye shes dam pa'i sprul pa ni 'gro ba gang dang gang gi gtso bo la sogs par snang bas don mdzad pa ste/ de yang rang snang lhun grub stu ga po bkod pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo las rang byung ba/ sprul pa'i sku rdo rje 'chang chen pos longs spyod rdzogs pa'i cha byad du zhing 'di'i bskal pa dang po dga' ldan brtsegs pa zhes bya bar pad+ma'i steng du rang byon nas rdo rje sems dpa' dang phyag na rdo rje la rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i chos tshig dang yi ge las 'das pa dgongs pas rang snang du go bar mdzad do/ /de'i tshe rdo rje 'chang nyid khye'u snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba'i ston pa phun sum tshogs par rang byon nas 'khor phun sum tshogs pa bskal ba bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong la/ chos phun sum tshogs pa sgra thal 'gyur rtsa ba'i rgyud la sogs pa yang gsang 'od gsal gyi rgyud bcu bdun/ klong gsal nyi ma'i rgyud dang bco brgyad/ dus phun sum tshogs pa ye shes rang snang ba'i tshe rang shar du gsungs so/ /de'ang ston pa dang*/ 'khor tha dad med kyang 'gro ba 'dul ba la dgongs nas so sor snang ba'o/ /ji ltar zhe na/ bskal pa 'di la sangs rgyas kyi mtshan tha dad/

dus tha dad/ chos tha dad pas 'dul bar dgongs nas rim pa dang tha dad par byon pa'o/ /skabs 'dir rdo rje 'chang gis rdo rje sems dpa' dang phyag na rdo rje la gsungs pa nas brgyud par bgrang ngo*/ /de nas sprul sku mched tshul bskal pa dang por dga' ldan brtsegs par sta ོ na pa khye'u snang ba dam pa byon pa'i 'og tu gnas 'jig rten mi mjed du ston pa khye'u 'od mi 'khrugs pa byon no/ /de nas gnas 'od kyi phung por ston pa 'jigs pa skyob pa dang*/ gnas chags 'byung mngal du snang bar ston pa gzhon nu rol pas rnam par rtse ba dang*/ gnas ri rab kyi lho phyogs 'tsho byed gzhon nu'i ldum rar ston pa rdo rje 'chang dang*/ gsang chen rol pa'i dur khrod du ston pa gzhon nu dpa' bo stobs ldan dang*/ gnas srin po ru lu'i sgra dang ldan par ston pa drang srong khros pa'i rgyal po dang*/ bya rgod phung po la ston pa gser 'od dam pa dang*/ sog po g.yu'i smin ma can gyi gnas su ston pa brtse bas rol pa'i blo gros dang*/ bya rgod phung por ston pa 'od srung bgra ེ sa po dang*/ rdo rje gdan du ston pa mngon rdzogs rgyal po dang*/ ser skya'i gnas su ston pa shākya thub pa'i bar du byon te/ tshe lo dpag tu med pa nas brgya pa'i bar du 'gro ba rnams kyi ded dpon dam par byon pa'o/ /de bzhin du ma 'ongs pa na byams pa 'byung ba nas bzung ste/ tha ma sangs rgyas mos pa'i bar du 'gro ba rnams kyi kha lo sgyur ba rim par 'byung ba yin no/ /de ltar byon pa'i rgyal ba rnams kyang kun tu bzang po gcig gi ngo bo las/ dus de dang de dag tu rang 'byung ba'i phyir dgongs pa chos nyid las mi g.yo bar rim par byung ba ltar snang bas rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa zhes bya'o// // ༈ don gnyis pa rig 'dzin brda'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes ri rab kyi byang phyogs dur khrod me ri 'bar ba'i gnas na/

mkha' 'gro ma dang grub pa dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa rnams la chos ston pa na/ rdo rje gdan gyi nub phyogs o rgyan thor cog can gyi yul na rgyal po u pa rā tsa dang*/ btsun mo snang ba gsal ba'i 'od ldan ma gnyis kyi sras mo su dharmā zhes bya ba'i dge slong ma zhig rgya mtsho'i gling du dka' thub la bzhugs pa'i rmi lam du shel gyi mi dkar po zhig gis rin po che'i bum pa spyi bor bzhag pa rmis te/ zla ba bcu nas khye'u zhig btsas pa las yum bred de/ pha med bu 'di 'jig rten 'dre las gzhan pa su/ /gal te lha dang lha min sna tshogs gzugs/ / 'di ltar byung ba'i dpe ni sus mthong med/ /'di ni log sred 'gro bas dpyas gyur sdig re che/ /zhes smras te thal ba'i khung du sbas pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ lha dang klu thams cad kyis mchod pa byed par mthong ste slar bzod par gsol nas ro langs bde ba zhes mtshan gsol pa las/ lo bdun nas sangs rgyas kyi chos mang po thugs la rang shar te yum la zhus nas/ u rgyan gyi yul du rgyal po'i mchod gnas paṇ+ḍi ta lnga brgya dang rtsod pa las/ slob dpon rgyal nas pad nya bha bar mtshan gsol dus/ rgyal po dgyes nas dga' rab rdo rje zhes mtshan gsol/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis ro langs thal mdog ces mtshan gsol lo/ /de nas ri bo nyi ma snang byed la sku mnyam par bzhag nas/ slar yang dur khrod me ri 'bar bar phyag na rdo rje las rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i chos thams cad gsan nas ma la ya bstan pa'i las rgyas pa'i rtser byon te/ rgyud lung rnams glegs bam du bkod nas mkha' 'gro ma rnams la gtad nas/ slob dpon nyid dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal du bzhugs so// // ༈ de'i tshe rgya nag po'i yul grong khyer sho 'khyams nag po zhes bya ba na/ khyim bdag dge ba dang ldan pa'i yid can dang*/ yum snang ba rab tu mkhyen ldan ma zhes bya ba'i sras/

slob dpon chen po shrī sing ha zhes bya ba sbyangs pa'i yon tan du ma dang ldan pa zhig grong khyer de nas nub phyogs kyi grong khyer gser gling zhes bya bar 'gro ba'i bar gyi thang stong zhig gi nam mkha' las/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang pos lung bstan pa/ kye skal ldan 'bras bu tshe gcig gis nges par thob par 'dod na/ rgya gar gyi rdo rje gdan gyi nub phyogs na dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal zhes bya ba yod kyi der song zhig ces pa dang*/ ri bo rtse lnga'i shar phyogs kyi khrus kyi rdzing bu'i nang du'ang de kho na bzhin du lung bstan pa la brten nas/ rkang mgyogs kyi rdzu 'phrul bsgrubs nas byon pa zhag dgu na dur khrod bsil tshal du phyin te/ slob dpon chen po dga' rab rdo rje dang zhal mjal nas rjes su gzung bar zhus pas gnang ste/ gsang ba bla na med pa mkha' 'gro snying tig gi dbang khrid rgyud man ngag dang bcas pa rdzogs par gnang zhing sgrub pa mdzad pas/ 'od gsal chu'i zla ba lta bu'i lus thob nas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub brnyes so/ /de'i tshe ma mo dang mkha' 'gro rnams kyis rang rang gi snying po phul zhing bstan pa skyong bar khas blangs te mchod pa'i sprin phung chen po gtibs so/ /de nas slob dpon chen po shrī sing ha nyid/ dur khrod de las dpag tshad gsum 'das pa na/ dur khrod chen po rtsub 'gyur tshal zhes bya ba/ nyin bzhin du rlung 'tshubs shing*/ mtshan bzhan du me 'bar ba na/ ma mo dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma mang po rgyu ba/ dag byed kyi mtsho dang*/ bde byed kyi mchod rten dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i lha dga' byed dbang phyug gnas par byon te/ brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad cing ma mo mkha' 'gro ma rnams la chos ston pa'i phyir bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe dpal u rgyan gyi yul du/ rin po che 'bar ba'i grong khyer na/ bai ḍūr+ya'i pho brang phyi nang thams cad shin tu rnam par dag pa nor bu sgron me'i snang bas khyab pa na rgyal po in+d+ra bhu dhi btsun ma brgya rtsa brgyad dang lhan cig phyi nang gi blon pos bskor nas bzhugs pa las/

sras rgyal bu mi mnga' nas/ dbyar zla ra ba'i tshes bco lnga nas dkon mchog mchod de/ chos kyi sprin zhes bya ba'i mdo sde bton nas/ sbyin gtong gi khang pa chen po brtsegs te skye dgu mang po la sbyin pa rlabs po che btang nas lo mang zhig song ba na/ dkor mdzod thams cad zad cing stongs su nye yang slong mo ba'i 'phro ma chad nas/ las su bskos pa'i mis da ni bang mdzod thams cad zad cing stong pas khyed cag la sbyin rgyu med do smras pa dang*/ glo bur du lhag pa kha cig na re/ bdag cag la ma byin na sngar sbyin pa thams cad don med do/ / zhes smras pa gsan nas/ rgyal pos longs spyod zad mi shes pa'i thabs dris pas/ rgya mtsho'i gling na klu yi bu mo mdzes ldan ma'i lag na yid bzhin nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung yod de/ byang chub sems dpa' sems can la snying rjes lhags pas bslad na ster bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsol bas/ rgya mtsho'i gling las nor bu lan mang du blangs pa'i ded dpon zhig yod pa la bka' bsgo ba/ kho bo ni rgya mtsho'i gling las nor bu len par 'dod kyi khyed kyis lam bstan par rigs so/ /zhes gsungs pas/ des kyang de ltar bgyi'o legs so zhes gsol nas rgya mtshor dgos pa'i yo byad rnams sta gon du byas so/ /de'i tshe blon po rnams kyis mi bzhud par gsol kyang ma gnang ste/ legs par grub pa'i nyi ma la/ gzings kyi nang du tshong pa lnga brgya'i 'khor dang lhan cig gshegs so/ /de nas gzings kyi phyogs bzhir dar po che bzhi phyar te mthun pa'i rlung gi tshe 'gro ba dang*/ mtshams bzhir zha ne'i pha wang chen po bzhi 'phyang du bcug ste mi mthun pa'i rlung gi tshe sdod pa dang*/ bya rog dang dung dang phug ron rnams ni/ ri dang chu srin brtags nas bsad pa dang*/ rang gi yul phyogs ngos bzung ba'i phyir khyer te/ mthun pa'i rlung dang sbyar nas gzings kyi nyal thag bcad de/

ngang pa'i rgyal po nam mkha' la 'gro ba bzhin du song song ba las/ nyin zhag mang zhig na/ rin po che'i gling nor bu sna tshogs kyi bye ma brdal ba zhig tu phyin pa dang*/ 'khor rnams de nyid du bzhag nas/ rgyal po dang ded dpon gnyis gru chung ngu zhig tu zhugs te de las kyang 'das te song ba na/ nyin zhag 'ga' zhig na ri dkar po zhig mthong nas rgyal pos dris pas dngul gyi ri yin zer ro/ /yang de las kyang 'das te song ba na/ ri sngon po zhig mthong nas dris pas bai ḍūr+ya'i ri yin zer ro/ /yang de las kyang las te song ba na/ ri ser po zhig mthong nas dris pas gser gyi ri yin te bdag cag deng ba'i gnas lags so zhes smras te song ba na/ ri de'i 'dabs gser gyi bye ma brdal ba'i sa gzhi'i mtshams su slebs pa dang*/ ded dpon gyis rgyal po la bsgo ba/ ri 'di'i steng na rin po che sna tshogs kyi khang bu zhig yod de/ de'i mdun na rdo rje'i gtun bu zhig yod kyi des sgo rdungs la sems can la phan pa'i don du nor bu rin po che 'dod do zhes brda sbyor la ci yang ma smra bar bzhugs shig dang*/ klu'i bu mo mang pos nor bu 'bul du 'ong gi de dag la ci yang ma smra zhig /der klu'i bu mo mdzes ldan mas nor bu rin po che 'bul du yong gi myur du longs la gos kyis gril spyi bor bsnams la byon cig ces legs par gdams pa bzhin/ rin po che'i khang bu'i sgo brdungs pas thog mar klu'i bu mo brgyas nor bu phul yang ma blangs par da dung sgo brdungs pas/ rting la klu'i bu mo mdzes ldan ma sngon mo shin tu mdzes shing lta bas mi ngoms pa zhig phyir byung nas spyi gtsug gi nor bu phul ba dang*/ myur bar logs te ded dpon dang lhan cig rang gi 'khor rnams gnas pa'i gling der nor bu'i byin rlabs kyis nam mkha' las byon pa na/ thams cad ya mtshan skyes te phyag byas so/

/de nas ded dpon gyis legs par brtags pas rin po che sna bdun gzings su yang lji ran par brdzong ste/ gzings kyi kha lo sgyur nas 'ongs pa na/ rgya mtsho'i gling gcig na/ pad+ma'i sdong po shin tu mdzes pa'i steng na/ khye'u lo brgyad lon pa'i na tshod can/ shin tu mdzes shing lta bas mi ngoms pa mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa zhig mthong nas/ de'i drung du song ste rgyal pos smras pa/ khye'u khyod kyi pha ni gang*/ ma ni gang*/ rigs ni gang*/ ming ni gang*/ yul ni gang*/ zas ni gang*/ 'dir don ci byed dris pas/ khye'us gsungs pa/ pha ni rang rig kun tu bzang*/ /ma ni chos dbyings kun bzang mo/ /rigs ni dbyings rig gnyis su med/ /ming ni pad+ma 'byung gnas dpal/ /yul ni chos dbyings skye ba med/ /zas ni gnyis snang rtog pa za/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyod pa byed/ /ces gsungs pas rgyal po ngo mtshar skyes te/ sprul pa'i sku zhig 'khrungs 'dug pas bdag gi bur gsol ba gdab snyam nas smras pa/ bdag gi mchod gnas dang sras su gshegs par ci gnang zhes zhus pas/ de ltar bgyi'o gsungs nas gnang ba dang*/ pad+ma'i sdong po bcad de/ khye'u de nyid dang nor bu dang bcas pa rang gi 'khor rnams kyis bskor te/ u rgyan gyi yul tu phyin pa na/ pho brang 'khor gyi mi thams cad kyis bsu ba chen po byas te/ bai ḍūr+ya'i pho brang du gshegs pa las/ rgyal pos smon pa/ ngas rnyed pa'i nor bu 'di yang dag pa yin na/ khye'u 'di bzhugs pa'i rin po che'i khri dang gdugs rang byung bar gyur cig ces brjod ma thag tu byung ngo*/ /de la khye'u bzhugs te rgyal srid la mnga' gsol nas mtshan pad+ma rgyal po zhes grags so/ /yang rgyal pos smon pa/ nga'i pho brang 'khor du zhag bdun du rin po che'i char bab cing bang mdzod stongs pa rnams sngon pas gang bar gyur cig / ces brjod ma thag tu de bzhin du byung ngo*/

/de'i tshe rnga bo che brdungs nas phyogs thams cad du bsgrags pa/ rgyal po in+d+ra bho dhi'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu las dgos 'dod kyi char 'bebs pas su ci 'dod pa gang la gang 'dod pa longs shig ces brjod nas/ nor bu rin po che rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mor btags shing mchod nas khrus chab gsol te/ rgyal pos smon lam btab pa/ ngas rnyed pa'i nor bu rin po che 'di yang dag pa yin nges na/ sems can thams cad la ci 'dod pa'i char phob cig ces brjod ma thag kha zas dang*/ gos dang longs spyod kyi char chen po bab cing*/ rgyal 'bangs thams cad dbul phongs dang bral bar byas so/ /de nas rgyal pos bka' bsgo ba/ da ni khyed thams cad theg pa chen po'i chos la spyod cig ces gsungs te/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed du bcug pas/ /thams cad kyis bla na med pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa'i 'bras bu thob bo/ /de nas slob dpon chen po nyid rgyal srid ni chos dang mi mthun zhing sems can gyi don yang mi 'ong bar dgongs nas/ rgyal po dang blon po rnams sun 'byung ba'i phyir/ brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad de/ sku gcer bu la rus pa'i rgyan gsol/ kha ṭ+wām̐ ga phyag na bsnams te gar mdzad pas/ pho brang gi rtser gar la lta ba'i mi mang po tshogs pa las/ kha ṭ+wām̐ ga phyag nas shor ba ltar mdzad de/ blon po dbang po che ka ma ta'i bu'i mgo la bsnun nas shi'o/ /rgyal khrims la gang gis 'das kyang chad pa'i las gcod pas/ blon po kun tshogs te/ rgyal po la zhus pas/ rgyal bur mnga' gsol yang tshul ma yin pa spyod pas/ blon po'i bu nyes pa med par bsad pas/ da ni gsal shing gi rtse la bskyon nas chad pa gcad 'tshal zhes zhus pas/ rgyal pos gal gyis gcus kyang ma nyan par/ 'o na spyugs par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas legs so zhes brjod de/ de nas rgyal po thugs ma bde bzhin du slob dpon la gsungs pa/

rin chen mtsho dkyil pad+ma'i sdong po las/ khye'u pha dang ma med sprul pa'i sku/ /brtul zhugs spyod pas blon po'i phrug gu bkums/ /blon pa rnams kyis rgyal khrims chad pa gcod/ /gsod las spyugs par snang bas gang dgar bzhud/ /ces smras pa dang*/ slob dpon gyis gsungs pa/ 'jig rten 'di na pha dang ma dkon yang*/ /yab dang yum du bgyis nas rgyal sar phyung*/ /las kyi lan chags blon po'i phrug gu bsad/ /yul la zhen pa med pas spyugs kyang 'jigs pa med/ /skye 'chi gnyis su med pas bsad kyang 'jigs pa med/ /rgyal khrims gnyan pas spyugs pa shin tu legs/ /yab yum dag kyang yun du bde bar bzhugs/ /las kyi 'brel pas phyi nas mjal bar nges/ /zhes gsungs te phyag mdzad nas byon pa na/ blon po rnams kyis dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal zhes bya ba shin tu 'jigs shing skyi bung ba'i gnas su bskyal lo/ /der ro zas dang ro gos la longs spyod cing bzhugs pas mkha' 'gro ma thams cad dbang du 'dus te mtshan yang pad+ma thod phreng rtsal zhes grags so/ /de nas dur khrod chen po dga' ba tshal dang*/ so sa gling dang*/ rgya mtsho'i gling la sogs pa rnams su byon te/ brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad pas/ gsang chen rdo rje phag mo la sogs ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma mang pos dbang bskur zhing mngon par bstod do/ /gzhan yang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pa grub cing*/ dbang du 'dus pas mtshan mtsho skyes rdo rje drag po rtsal zhes grags shing*/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub rnyed do/ /de ltar chos thams cad la mnga' brnyes shing rang bzhin sprul pa'i sku chen por bzhugs kyang 'gro ba'i khams dang mos pa sna tshogs pas de dag gi mi dad pa bzlog pa'i phyir/ rgya gar gyi bla ma mkhas grub rnams las thos bsam mdzad de/ slob dpon pra bha hasti'i drung du rab tu byung nas shākya seng ge zhes mtshan gsol/

slob dpon klu sgrub snying po dang*/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang*/ dge slong ma kun dga' mo la sogs pa las/ rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa mtha' dag gsan nas mkhyen par mdzad cing*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha dpag tu med pas zhal gzigs so/ /mu stegs pa dang rtsod pa mdzad pas mu stegs pham par byas nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la btsud pas mtshan seng ge sgra sgrog ces grags so/ /de nas slob dpon chen po shrī seng ha'i drung du/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud la sogs pa rdzogs pa chen po sems klong man ngag gi skor rnams rdzogs par zhus shing*/ khyad par du thig le phyi nang gsang ba'i skor rnams gsan dus/ yang zhus pa/ slob dpon chen po lags/ tshe 'di nyid la zag bcas kyi phung po mi snang bar longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i zhing khams mthong zhing*/ chos kyi sku'i zhing du sangs rgya ba'i gdams pa zhig gnang 'tshal zhes zhus pas/ slob dpon chen po shrī sing ha'i gsung gis/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis zhus pa de shin tu legs kyi/ theg pa thams cad kyi yang rtse/ lta ba thams cad kyi zhe phugs/ mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi snying thig /gsang ba bas kyang ches shin tu gsang ba'i don/ tshe 'di nyid la gdos bcas sha khrag gi phung po 'od gsal longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur grol nas myur du sangs rgyas kyi byang chub 'grub pa'i gdams pa zhig yod kyi bstan par bya'o gsungs nas/ gsang ba mkha' 'gro snying tig gi dbang khrid man ngag dang bcas pa gnang nas lo gsum bsgrubs pas/ skye shi gnyis spangs rdo rje'i sku thob ste sprul pas yul sna tshogs su mi dang mi ma yin pa mang po la phan pa mdzad cing*/ khyad par du rgya gar gyi rgyal po dharmā pa la'i mchod gnas su nyin par bzhugs shing*/ mtshan mo dur khrod chen po brgyad la sogs par/ mkha' 'gro 'bar ba'i sprin phung dang lhan cig gsang sngags kyi kun tu spyod pas gnas par mdzad do/

/de'i tshe 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa bod kyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis bsam yas kyi sa gzhi 'dul ba'i don du spyan drong pas/ sngon gyi smon lam dang thugs rje'i dbang gis bod kyi yul du byon te/ sa gzhi btul zhing lha srin gdug pa can thams cad dam la btags nas/ gtsug lag khang bzhengs su gsol bas/ dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po nyi 'og gi rgyal khams nas 'gran zla dang bral bar grub cing*/ rab tu gnas pa/ dga' ston chen po dang bcas pa mdzad do/ /de nas slob dpon chen po pho brang rim khang du spyan drangs te gsol zas sna tshogs ky-i tshogs kyi 'khor los mchod de/ 'jig rten gyi spyan gzigs mang po dang*/ dgyes pa'i btsun mo phul nas gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos bsgyur bar zhus pas gnang ste/ sgra bsgyur rgya gar gyi gling du slob dpon nyid dang*/ sprul pa'i lo tsā ba bai ro tsa na dang*/ gnyags ku ma ra la sogs pas rgyud dpag tu med pa bsgyur zhing*/ de dag gi sgrub thabs kyi rim pa mdzad de/ so sor bsgrubs pas/ grub thob nyi shu rtsa lnga la sogs pa grub pa thob pa mang du byung zhing*/ bod 'bangs thams cad bde ba la bkod do/ /de nas slob dpon gyis phyi rabs kyi 'gro ba la phan gdags pa'i phyir/ rgyud lung man ngag rnams yi ger bris te so sor smon lam gyi rgya dang bcas nas gter du sbas so/ /de ltar 'gro ba mi rnams kyi don mdzad tshe/ bod dang lho mon gyi mi ma yin rnams kyis bdag cag rnams la yang dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes zhus pas gnang ste/ de dag gis spyan drangs byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas ni/ pa gro stag tshang seng ge phug /lho brag mkhar chu/ kha rag rin chen phug /shangs kyi zab bu lung*/ ti sgro brag dkar/ tsā ri tsā khang*/ rngams pa sgra sgrog la sogs pa rnams so/

/gzhan yang lo dang*/ zla ba dang*/ zhag dang*/ dros skad re tsam bzhugs pa'i gnas ni bsam gyis mi khyab bo// // ༈ de'i tshe cog ro 'bring mtshams kyi yul na/ mang rje thog dkar legs dang*/ ru bza'i rgyal mo mtsho 'dus te khyim 'dzin pa las/ rgyal mo mtsho'i rmi lam na/ nam mkha'i dky-il nas bud med sngon mo zha

ི ga gis 'od kyi skar ma zhig 'phangs pa khong pa'i nang du song ba rmis nas/ zla ba dgu ngo bcu na/ bu mo shin tu mdzes pa/ dpral ba la rdo rje rgya gram gyi ri mo yod pa ud+pala'i dri dang ldan pa zhig btsas pa las/ mtsho rgyal zhes btags te cher skyes pa las/ rgyal po'i btsun mor blangs pa na/ slob dpon la shin tu dad cing*/ 'khor ba'i chos la shin tu skyo nas/ rgyal po la chos byed par zhus pas/ gnang ste slob dpon la phul lo/ /de nas slob dpon gyis las rgya bgyis te gang du byon pa thams cad du byon nas/ bsnyen bkur dang zhabs tog mdzad cing sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad pas grub pa thob ste mchog thun mong gi dngos grub brnyes so/ /de nas slob dpon yab yum gzho stod ti sgro brag la sgrub pa mdzad pa'i dus su/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma mang pos jo mo la bskul ba/ slob dpon sprul pa'i sku'i thugs la tshe 'di nyid la gdos bcas kyi phung po dag nas sangs rgya ba'i gdams pa/ mngon sum snying tig gi man ngag zab mo bzhugs pas gsol ba thob cig ces bskul ba dang*/ de'i tshe jo mos tshogs kyi 'khor los mchod cing phyag dang bskor ba byas te zhus pa/ slob dpon chen po lags/ tshe 'di nyid la gdos bcas kyi phung po dag nas sangs rgya ba'i gdams pa mngon sum snying thig gi man ngag gnang 'tshal/ zhes zhus pas/ slob dpon chen po'i zhal nas/ mtsho rgyal khyod kyis zhus pa de shin tu legs shing*/ tshe 'di nyid la gdos bcas sha khrag gi phung po 'od gsal longs spyod rdzogs sku'i zhing khams su dag nas/ chos sku lhun grub tu rin po che'i sbubs su gtan srid zin par byed pa'i gdams pa zab mo zhig yod kyi bstan par bya'o/ /gsungs nas/ tshogs khang chen mor zhi khro don gyi dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas/ jo mo mkhar che bzas thog drangs ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma 'bum phrag gcig la dbang bskur nas khrid du mdzad de/

rgyu bcu bdun/ klong gsal dang bco brgyad/ de dag gi man ngag yi ge rab tu mang po dang bcas pa rnams gsungs so/ /de nas de rnams las rgyud rab tu rgyas pa'i man ngag rnams phyogs gcig tu phyes/ slob dpon nyid kyis mdzad pa'i zab 'dus ku su lu'i skor rnams phyogs gcig tu phyes te/ slob dpon dang mtsho rgyal gyis so so'i yi ge bris te dkar chag la mnan no/ /de'i tshe rgyal pos gdan drangs te/ 'chims phur slob dpon dang*/ rgyal po yab sras gshegs te tshogs kyi 'khor lo brgya rtsa mdzad pa las/ btsun mo dam pa 'brom bza' byang chub sman las 'khrungs pa'i sras mo lha lcam pad ma gsal zhes bya ba dgung lo brgyad lon pa cig shi bas/ lha sras bu mo'i ro la gzigs shing bshums te mya ngan mdzad pas/ slob dpon chen pos bka' stsal pa/ kye mnga' bdag rje/ spyir 'jig rten gyi snang ba rmi lam dang 'dra/ 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid sgyu ma yin/ rgyal srid mdang gi rmi lam dang 'dra/ tshe mi rtag chu'i lbu ba dang 'dra/ 'dus pa thams cad bral ba yin/ /'dus byas thams cad 'di dang 'dra/ /mi rtag rtag par ma 'dzin par/ /skye med chos sku'i don la sbyongs/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ yang rgyal pos zhus pa'i don du/ gtsug lag khang dang bstan pa'i dar gud 'byung tshul/ lha lcam gyi skyes rabs dang bcas pa rgyas par gsungs nas/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus su zangs mdog dpal rir rgyal po dang*/ /mtsho rgyal lha lcam pad ma gsal dang 'o skol zhal mjal lo gsungs pas/ rgyal po dgyes pas phyag dang bskor ba mang du mdzad do/ /de nas lha lcam gyi ro'i snying khar shes rab mtshal gyi yi ge nṛ gcig bris te rnam shes bkug pas dbugs byung ste smra shes pa byung ngo*/ / de'i tshe gsang ba mkha' 'gro snying tig gi dbang bskur nas gsang mtshan pad+ma las 'brel rtsal du btags shing*/ bu mo'i spyi bor dpe sgrom bzhag nas/

ma 'ongs pa'i dus su chos 'di dang 'phrad nas sems can la phan thog par shog cig /ces smon lam btab bo/ /de nas slar rnam shes don pa dang*/ ro de nyid sreg pa'i tshul bstan zhing mo'i sgrib pa sbyong ba'i don du/ slob dpon gyis rdzu 'phrul mdzad de skad cig la u rgyan du tshogs kyi 'khor lo mdzad do/ /yang slob dpon gyis gsungs pa/ ji ltar byung ba 'di dag yi ger thob cig /lha lcam mo rang gi skye ba dang 'phrad pa'i dus su yid ches pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /zhes gsung yi ger btab bo/ /de nas jo mos zhus pa/ snying thig zab mo'i gdams pa spel lam sba bar bya/ zhes zhus pas/ slob dpon chen pos gsungs pa/ 'di da lta spel ba'i dus la ma bab pas gter du sbed dgos/ lha lcam gyis smon lam btab pas mo'i chos skal yin zhing*/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus su snying tig snga 'gyur 'chal te cung zad nub tu nye ba na/ chos 'dis phan thogs par 'gyur bas gter du sbed dgos gsungs nas/ rgyud rab tu rgyas pa'i man ngag dang bcas pa rnams bum thang smad kyi brag seng ge 'dra ba la gter du sbas shing*/ zab 'dus ku su lu'i skor rnams dgas po dang lung khra mo brag la gter du sbas nas/ gza' dang ma mo dang gter bdag gi mkha' 'gro mang po la gnyer du gtad nas/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus su skal ldan las can de la gtod cig ces bka' bsgo bar mdzad do/ / gzhan yang sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i gter kha mang du sbas so/ /de ltar rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis/ dpal bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang chen po bzhengs/ slob dpon chen po pad ma 'byung gnas la sogs pa paṇ+ḍi ta mang po spyan drangs/ dam pa'i chos mang po bsgyur nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzad do/ /de nas drug cu rtsa gcig glang gi lo la rgyal po dgung la gshegs te/ slob dpon nyid kyang dngos kyi gdul bya de las med par dgongs nas lha sras mu ne btsan pos bzhugs par zhus kyang ma gnang ste gshegs pa'i tshe/

mang yul bye ma'i la so la thug par bskyal nas/ phyag dbu thod bud bud du 'tshal zhing bskor ba mdzad de/ nged bod la thugs rjes gzigs par zhu gsungs nas spyan chab mang po bton pas/ slob dpon chen po'i zhal nas/ lha sras btsan po/ 'jig rten gyi snang ba sgyu ma dang 'dra bas skye med chos sku'i rtsal sbyong mdzod cig /'dus byas chu'i lbu ba dang 'dra bas 'jig med thar pa'i lam sna zung zhig /mi rtag rtswa kha'i zil pa dang 'dra bas sems nyid gnyug ma'i gtan srid zung zhig 'dus pa tshong khang gi mgron po dang 'dra bas 'bral med bde chen gyi grogs dang 'grogs shig /'di phyir phan pa dam pa'i chos las med pas rje 'bangs thams cad dam pa'i lha chos mdzod cig /spre'u lo spre'u zla ba'i tshes bcu la nga yang bod kyi yul du lan re 'ong zhing*/ las can rnams la rgyun du snang bas thugs ngal mi mdzad par ci bder bzhugs 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsung nas/ slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas dang*/ jo mo mkhar che mtsho rgyal gnyis/ nam mkha'i dbyings na phar 'od zer gyi phung po dang bcas te lho nub rnga yab kyi gling du bun gyis gshegs so/ /de ltar rim gyis byon pa'i bla ma bzhi po de yang*/ kun tu bzang po yab yum dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa' nyid kyi rnam par 'phrul pa las/ 'gro ba rang rgyud pa 'gas bsgrubs pas grub pa thob pa ni ma yin no/ /de'i phyir gdul bya'i snang ba dang bstun nas de ltar byon pa'o// // ༈ don gsum pa gang zag snyan khung du brgyud pa ni/ de ltar u rgyan chen pos lung bstan pa bzhin/ lha lcam pad ma gsal skye ba rim gyis brgyud pa las/ tshe lo lnga bcu kha ral gyi tshe/ gsal rje gong gi shar phyogs 'bri thang zhes bya ba'i sa char sku 'khrungs te/ chung ngu'i dus na chos la mos pas rab tu byung ste mtshan tshul khrims rdo rje zhes grags so/ /de'i tshe gter gyi kha byang dang lde mig phyag tu byung zhing*/

gter bdag gi mkha' 'gro rnams kyis yang yang bskul ba la brten nas dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gsum gyi steng du/ zab mo mkha' 'gro snying tig gi gter kha dwags po dang lung khra mo brag nas gdan drangs nas cung zad spel bar mdzad cing khyad par du las can gyi slob ma sprul sku legs ldan la bka' lung shog ser dang bcas pa gtad nas 'dzin zhen med pa'i spyod pas gnas nges med du 'byon pa las/ byar smad phying dkar zhes bya ba'i sa char sku gshegs te pur sbyangs pa las/ gdung rus la rdo rje phag mo tshon gang ba'i sku dang*/ ring bsrel mang du byon cing zhag bdun du lung pa 'ja' 'od kyis gang bas 'gro ba rnams ngo mtshar gyi sa la bkod do/ / de lta bu'i bla ma zab gter gyi bdag po de nyid las/ sprul sku legs ldan pas bka' lung man ngag rdzogs par zhus te/ de'ang dpal ldan bla ma dam pa sprul sku legs ldan gyi 'khrungs yul ni/ dmyal smad chos gro se ba lung zhes bya ba'i gnas su/ sngags brgyud khyad par can gyi rigs slob dpon dbang phyug rgyal dang*/ gru mo rdo rje dgos gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs te/ sku chung ngu'i dus nas sngon gyi skye ba mang po dran pa dang yi ge 'bri klog bslab ma dgos par mkhyen pa dang*/ thugs rab chen po mnga' 'o/ /grub thob u rgyan pa dang rtogs ldan mgon po ye shes kyis kyang sems can la phan thogs pa'i skyes bu zhig 'ong bar 'dug gsungs nas lung bstan/ dgung lo brgyad lon dus ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mas dngos su lung bstan zhing yab mes kyi zab chos rnams kyi bdag por byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas gsung rab kyi gnas la thos bsam mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ yab las rig pa bklag pa sgra'i bstan bcos/ rnam gzhag zhib mo gaṅga'i chu rgyun/ skye bo gso ba'i thig pa rtsa 'grel dang bcas pa dang*/ rta mgrin dang thugs rje chen po dang*/ sgrol ma'i rgyud sgrub thabs dang bcas pa dang*/

ma mgon gyi rgyud man ngag dang bcas pa rnams gsan nas mkhyen par mdzad cing*/ bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa zhes bya ba las/ zhi byed brgyud pa phyi ma'i dbang dang gdams pa rnams gsan no/ khu bo bla ma rgyal sras brtson dbang pa'i drung du slob gnyer la byon dus bla ma'i gsung gi rmis ltas shin tu bzang sems can la phan legs par thogs pa cig 'ong bar 'dug pas/ khyed kyi ming rgyal sras legs ldan thogs shig gsungs so/ /de'i tshe dpal gsang ba snying po'i rgyud dang*/ brtag gnyis gsan nas nan chags mdzad de/ bshad pa mdzad cing*/ gzhan yang 'jam dpal kha thun gyi rgyud dang*/ 'jam dpal tshe bdag khro bo 'dus pa'i skor dang*/ bde mchog man ngag dang bcas pa dang*/ khro phu'i lo tsā nas brgyud pa'i chos skor rnams dang*/ 'jig rten mgon po chos rje 'bri gung pa'i chos skor la sogs pa gdams pa mang du zhus so/ slob dpon sangs rgyas dbon gzhon las/ ro snyoms skor drug la sogs pa 'brug pa'i chos skor rnams gsan zhing*/ bla ma chos rgyal rdza ma pa las/ phar phyin shes rab sgron me dang*/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa dang*/ dgyes rdor rngog lugs dang*/ sangs rgyas thod pa dang*/ phag mo dpyal gyi chos drug la sogs pa zhus so/ /bon sgom snang ba rgyal yan las/ do ha skor gsum 'grel pa bal lugs par lugs dang bcas pa zhus shing*/ slob dpon glan las mnga' bdag nyang ral gyi gter kha bde gshegs 'dus pa'i bka' lung*/ rta mgrin gyi rgyud lnga sgrub thabs dang bcas pa dang*/ thugs rje chen po 'gro 'dul gyi chos skor dang*/ mkha' 'gro yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub skor la sogs pa zhus so/ /gu ru'i brgyud 'dzin nyi ma 'od zer las/ bla ma gsang 'dus sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ thugs rje chen po yang snying 'dus pa la sogs pa zhus shing ri khrod ras pa las/ gzer lnga dang lam mchog mthar thug la sogs pa zhang tshal ba'i gdams skor rnams gsan no/

/zhig po'i 'jigs med sbas pa las/ bi ma la'i snying tig gi dbang khrid zab pa pod bzhi/ rgyud bcu bdun dang bcas pa zhus shing*/ rnal 'byor pa ā hūm̐ rdo rje las sgrags yang rdzong ma'i gter kha'i chosaskor rnams gsan no/ /'jam dbyangs shes rab rin chen las lnga bsdus kyi rtsis dang*/ gso ba sman dpyad kyi skor dang phan byed kyi las tshogs mang du zhus te mkhyen par mdzad do/ khyad par du gter ston pad+ma ma las 'brel rtsal las zab mo mkha' 'gro snying tig gi dbang khrid gdams pa dang bcas pa rdzogs par zhu dus/ bla ma'i gsung gis chos 'di'i bdag po khyod yin par lung bstan na 'dug pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzod cig / gsungs nas shog ser rnams kyang phyag tu gtad do/ /de nas zab gter 'di nyid lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du gang la yang ma spel bar sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad pa'i tshe mnal lam du/ zangs mdog dpal rir u rgyan pad ma dang zhal 'jal ba dang*/ gnubs nam mkha'i snying pos sing lding gi rnga gtad nas las can gyi slob mar lung bstan pa la sogs mtshan ltas bzang po mang du byung zhing*/ nyams rtogs kyi nus pa phun sum tshogs pa mnga' bas smin grol gyi nus pa dang ldan par bzhugs pa las/ chos rje karma pa rang byung rdo rjes kong por gdan drangs te zab gter mkha' 'gro snying tig gi khrid gdams pa dang bcas pa rdzogs par gsan te/ dgyes tshor chen po mdzad cing chos bka' bkrol nas rgya cher spel bar mdzad do/ /de'i tshe chos rje pa las kyang*/ dus 'khor gyi rgyud 'grel pa dri med 'od dang*/ mdo sde skyes rabs kyi lung dang*/ sbyor drug chos drug /yang dgon pa'i ri chos skor gsum la sogs pa gdams pa mang du gsan no/ /de ltar ngo mtshar mchog gis brgyan pa'i bla ma dam pa de nyid ni/ o rgyan chen pos zab gter 'di nyid tshul dang mthun par spel ba'i las can gyi slob mar lung bstan zhing*/

zhi rgyas dbang drag gi nus pa chen po mnga' ba dang*/ gter yig nas lung bstan pa ltar sku tshe mthar phyin zhing gdul bya phrin las rnams smin grol la bkod de/ /dgung lo bdun cu rtsa brgyad kyi bar du bzhugs nas/ sbrul lo rgyal gyi zla ba'i tshes bcu la 'gro ba rnams ngo mtshar gyi sa la bkod nas/ gshegs pa'i tshul bstan pa'i tshe lha sku ring bsrel la sogs mang du byon zhing*/ lung pa 'ja' yis khengs pa la sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dpag tu med pa dang bcas te 'da' tshul bstan no/ /bla ma dam pa de nyid las/ bdag gis zab gter gyi gdams pa legs par zhus te/ de'ang bdag cag gi pha yul khams kyi sa cha la gong zhes bya ba yin cing*/ ldong klu 'phel zhes bya ba dang*/ mar tsha bza' a 'do gnyis kyi bur skyes te/ byis pa lo bdun brgyad kyi dus nas/ chos kyi bag chags dum pa yod pa 'dra bas/ chos byed par mos pa dang*/ bla ma dge 'dun gyi rigs dang*/ lha rten gsung rab la sogs mthong dus dga' tshor chen po skye ba zhig yod la/ sprang po la sogs ma nus pa mthong dus/ rang gi gos rnying dang*/ bza' btung cung zad ster par nus pa dang*/ byams pa zhig yod cing lo bco lnga lon dus 'bri gung du spyan snga badz+ra rā tsa bzhugs dus dge tshul byas nas yig brgya'i khrid lnga ldan gyi ngo sprod thob cing*/ de nas nang sor lo shas bsdad dus kyang*/ sdig pa cher ma 'bags shing*/ sprang long la byams pas bza' btung ster ba dang ma ṇi bskul/ rang yang ma ṇi mang po 'dren pa las/ lo nyi shu rtsa gcig lon pa'i skabs su/ mtshan gcig gi rmi lam na/ bud med rgyan mang pos brgyan pa 'khor mang rabs kyis bskor ba cig phyogs gzhan zhig tu 'gro ba'i lam zhor la bdag la 'di skad zer te khyod chos ma byas na lo nyi shu rtsa lnga'i steng du 'chi bas chos rang gyis shig thos so/ /de nas bzung ste/ myur du 'chi dogs pa'i sdug bsngal dang*/

'jig rten gyi bya ba la dgos pa ci yang mi 'dug /'di ltar mi thams cad tshe yud tsam 'di la chags sdang rmongs gsum sdig pa mi byed thang pa la/ da ni gang gis kyang dgos pa mi gda' chos rang bsam pa'i skyo shas dang mi rtag pa gzhan bskul ma dgos pa dung dung 'byung ba la/ yang lo shas dge sbyor la ma tshud/ de nas lo nyi shu rtsa lnga'i steng du bsnyen rdzogs byas te/ dpal kun tu bzang po'i rnam par 'phrul pa drin chen rin po che rgyal sras dri med 'od zer gyi drung du mjal bas thugs rjes bzung ste/ gsang ba snying tig dbang khrid/ zab pa pod bzhi rgyab yig dang bcas pa/ man ngag skor mang rabs dang*/ rgyud bcu bdun/ de'i don 'grel theg mchog mdzod/ zab mo yang tig

/ngal gso skor gsum gyi rtsa 'grel/ yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod la sogs pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro snying tig gi khrid/ yang tig dang bcas pa dang*/ gsang skor gyi dbang khrid rgyud man ngag dang bcas pa dang*/ kun byed rgyal po bang mdzod 'phrul gyi lde mig /bai ro tsa na'i 'dra 'bag la sogs pa dang*/ gu ru zhi drag gi sgrub skor dbang byin rlabs dang bcas pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub skor dang bcas pa zhus shing shin tu thugs mnyes par mdzad do/ /gtsug gi rgyan gcig mdzad pas bka' drin che bar bdog go /gzhan yang bla ma blo bzang ba las/ sems bskyed dbu ma lugs dang phyag rgya chen po thog bab dang*/ yi ge bzhi pa'i ngo sprod dang sgrol ma dkar sngon gyi rjes gnang sgrub thabs la sogs pa zhus so/ /bla ma rgyal rong ba las lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi gdams pa la sogs zhus shing*/ bla ma tsā ri ba las thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid dang mal gca ོ da la sogs zhus so/ / bla ma yon tan rgya mtsho las sbyor drug gi khrid dang ro snyoms sgang dril la sogs gdams phran mang du zhus so/ /chos rje kun mkhyen pa las/ sbyor drug gi ngo sprod/ khong rang gis mdzad pa'i man ngag ngo sprod dang 'pho ba khyad 'phags la sogs pa dang*/ 'jam dpal phan yon dang bcas pa'i lung zhus so/ /chos rje paṇa chen pa las/ dus 'khor gyi rgyud 'grel pa dri med 'od dang*/ mdo sde skyes rabs brgya rtsa dang*/ do ha skor gsum par bu'i 'grel pa dang bcas pa la sogs gdams pa mang du zhus so/ /bla ma lha khang pa las dbang rdor phreng dang sgrub thabs kyi skor 'ga' re zhus shing*/ chos rgyal rin chen gling pa las/ mkha' 'gro snying tig gi dbang khrid dang*/ rdzogs chen chig chod kun grol/ phyag rgyan chen po ma rig mun sel/ bla ma yid bzhin nor bu'i skor/ gu ru zhi drag /tshe dpag med la sogs gdams pa mang du zhus/

khyad par du tsā rir lo gcig gnyis sgrub pa byed pa'i zhar la/ bla ma dam pa sprul sku legs ldan pa byar gyi lung chung tsā ri nas nyin gcig slebs pa'i rtsa nas gro sa dgon pa zhes bya bar bzhugs pa la mjal te/ gsang ba bla na med pa mkha' 'gro snying tig gi dbang khrid gdams pa dang bcas pa lan gsum gyi bar la zhus te zhun thar bcad cing*/ gzhan yang khro phu lo tsā'i chos skor dang*/ paṇa chen shākya shrī'i gdams pa dang chos rje 'bri gung pa'i zab chos la sogs pa gdams pa mang du gnang zhing*/ thugs dgyes pa chen po dang bcas pas gzhan don gyis shig pa'i rjes gnang dang bcas pa mdzad do/ /de ltar bla ma dam pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa rnams las zab mo'i gdams pa mang du thos pa dang*/ khyad par du snying tig zab mo'i gdams pa nyid la/ yid ches dang ldan pas sgrub pa ci nus su byed pas bla ma la gsol ba 'debs shing bsam pa bzang pos snod ldan re re gnyis gnyis la zab mo'i gdams pa cung zad spel bar byed pa lags so/ /bdag ma gtogs pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams ni 'phags pa'i bla ma ngo mtshar can sha stag byon zhing*/ deng sang gi bar du dam tshig shin tu gtsang bas/ dbang gi chu bo yi zam ma chad/ byin rlabs kyi na bun drod ma yal/ bshad pa'i sgron me'i 'od ma nub pa'i tshul du yod pas/ phyi rabs rjes 'jug 'di nas brgyud pa rnams kyang chos dang mthun zhing dam tshig gtsang bas tshe 'di'i rnam g.yeng bskyungs te rang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs par mdzod cig /de ltar ngo mtshar mchog tshogs bla ma yi/ lo rgyus gsal bar bkod pa'i dge ba des/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i 'gro ba kun/ /kun bzang chos rje bla ma'i sa thob shog /mkha' 'gro snying tig gi bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus/ rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bya bral ba bzod pas/ dad ldan slob mas bskul ba'i ngor/ nyung bsdus yi ger bkod pa rdzogs so/
